preToolUse.powershell: $i = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); if (Get-Command mise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $i | mise exec --quiet -- node .agents/hooks/guard.ts copilot; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { exit 0 } }; if ($i -match '"(tool_name|toolName)" *: *"[^"]*(open_cloud_invoke|execute_luau)"|command\\?" *: *\\?"[^"\\]*(mise +run +publish|scripts/publish\.ts|rojo +upload)') { '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"The guard could not run (is mise installed?), so this call is blocked: it can act on the live game. Tell the user."}' }; exit 0

postToolUse.powershell: if (Get-Command mise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { mise exec --quiet -- node .agents/hooks/edited.ts copilot }; exit 0

agentStop.powershell: if (Get-Command mise -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { mise exec --quiet -- node .agents/hooks/check.ts copilot }; exit 0
